artworks.title: Christ
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up of a person's face and upper shoulders. The person's head is slightly tilted, with their gaze directed upward. The individual has prominent, large eyes and a solemn expression. The hair appears dark and wavy, flowing around the face, with a crown of thorns accentuating the top of the head. The individual is depicted in grayscale with a strong contrast between light and shadow. No jewelry or objects are held, and the background is textured with a cross-hatched pattern.

artworks.title: Elle tire de sa poitrine une eponge toute noire, la couvre de baisers (She draws from her bosom a sponge, perfectly black, and covers it with kisses)
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person standing slightly turned to their left. Their face is partly covered by a dark cloth over their mouth. Only their eyes and forehead are visible. The person's hair is mostly covered by a light-colored draped fabric that extends over their shoulders. They wear a garment with a high neckline featuring intricate designs near the chest area. The background is a textured space with shading and lines, lacking distinct features.

artworks.title: Hantise (Obsession)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure in a long flowing gown surrounded by floating faces and serpentine forms. The central focus is on a figure in profile, clad in a long dress, standing with an upright posture. The background is filled with shadowy forms, including two faces and a twisting shape extending from the top corners. The use of stark contrasts between light and dark areas enhances the mysterious feel of the composition.

artworks.title: Le Liseur (The reader)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in an armchair, leaning over a large open book on a table. The person has a prominent nose, a long beard, a bald head, and wears dark, simple clothing. The table has closed books and an object resembling a candle. The background features a window with square panes, casting intricate light patterns.

artworks.title: Quand s'eveillait la Vie au Fon de la  matiere obscure (When life was awakening in the depths of obscure matter)
artworks.description: The image displays swirling lines and irregular shapes, centered around an abstract animal form. The figure has a defined head and flowing body, resembling a lion or mythical beast, with detailed facial features and flowing mane-like elements. Circular forms and radial lines above the figure suggest celestial bodies or eyes in a textured darkness, creating a cosmic or dream-like atmosphere.

artworks.title: Il y eut peut-etre une vision premiere essayee dans la fleur (There was perhaps a first vision attempted in the flower)
artworks.description: This print displays intricate lines and stippling surrounding the shape of a large eye above center. Below this, there are lines forming a beak-like shape. The appearance is similar to a bird's head that has been rotated to the side, although the shapes are abstracted. The shapes could also suggest a strange, curved plant with a thick stem. Around the eye are two layers of thin feathered lines similar to eyelashes or fur.

artworks.title: Le Polype difforme flottait sur les rivages, sorte de cyclope souriant et hideux (The deformed polyp floated on the shores, a sort of smiling and hideous Cyclops)
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine appliqué on wove paper

artworks.title: La sirene sortit des flots vetue de dards (The Siren clothed in barbs, emerged from the waves
artworks.description: This print shows a creature with the upper body of a human and a serpent-like tail emerging from a swirling seascape, facing the left. They are looking over their shoulder at us, but their facial features are indistinct. They have short, dark hair and pale skin, and long spines or branches seem to emerge from their chest. The background is a blurred view of the water, with birds flying at the top and small waves at the bottom.

artworks.title: Le Satyre au cynique sourire (The Satyr with the cynical smile)
artworks.description: The sketch depicts the upper body of a person seen in profile from the left side. The focus is on the head, neck, and shoulders. The person's facial features are emphasized, with a large nose and wide eye. The hair is short, dark, and curly, with detailed shading. The figure is not wearing clothes or accessories. The background features intricate cross-hatched lines, providing texture.

artworks.title: Il y eut des luttes et des vaines victoires (There were struggles and vain victories)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a centaur triumphing over a serpent. The drawing depicts a centaur holding a long pole or spear, standing over a defeated serpentine creature on the ground. The serpent is shown curled and twisted. The centaur is portrayed with defined musculature and flowing hair. The use of shading and line work brings texture and depth to both creatures.

artworks.title: L'Aile impuissante n'eleva point la bete en ces noirs espaces (The impotent wing did not lift the animal into that black space
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines and shapes creating an abstract depiction resembling a creature with wings and hooves. The central shape may remind one of a horse, with elements like a body, mane, tail, and wings suggesting flight. The contrast between the dark background and the lighter creature enhances the abstract nature, blending familiar forms with imaginative elements.

artworks.title: Et l'homme parut, interrogeant le sol d'ou  il sort et qui l'attire, il se fraya la voie vers (And Man appeared; questioning theearth from which he emerged and which attracts hi m, he made his way toward somber brightness)
artworks.description: A drawing of a solitary figure in a contemplative pose. The figure is standing against a textured background. The focus is on muscular form and shadow, with a sense of tension or introspection. The background consists of cross-hatched and swirling lines, adding a dynamic quality. The overall palette is monochromatic, contributing to a somber and reflective mood.

artworks.title: Passage d'une Ame (Passage of a Spirit)
artworks.description: The image features flowing and curving lines creating an abstract form resembling a reclining figure. The shapes suggest a person leaning back with arms to the side, similar to a dancer or someone stretching. Dark shades offer depth, while lighter areas indicate highlights on the shoulders and head. The background displays a textured wall or dimly lit atmosphere, enhancing the figure's presence. The composition may evoke the graceful posture of a sculpture or a figure emerging from shadow.

artworks.title: C'etait un voile, un empreinte (It was a veil, an imprint)
artworks.description: The image depicts the head and shoulders of a person. The face is centrally framed with drawn features like deeply set eyes and a slightly furrowed brow. The hair appears long and flowing with wavy lines. No clothing details are visible. The background has a textured surface with a darker border. The image is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray. French text below the image reads, "c'était un voile, une EMPREINTE," translated to "it was a veil, an IMPRINT."

artworks.title: Et la-bas l'idole astrale, l'Apotheose (And beyond, the star idol, the apotheosis)
artworks.description: The image displays curved lines and shading forming an abstract figure holding a bow inside a circle. The circle can be seen as an orb or celestial body, while the figure resembles a mythological archer. The interplay of light and shadow creates a mysterious atmosphere.

artworks.title: Lueur precaire, une tete a l'infini suspendue(Precarious glimmering, a head suspended
artworks.description: This image features a rectangular frame with radiating lines holding the profile of a serene face. The face is suspended in a dark space, resembling a lantern or window. It emits a soft glow, reminiscent of moonlight or a distant star. Below the face, there are textured, wave-like forms and shadowy shapes suggesting undulating landscape or rough terrain, contrasting with the illuminated portrait and surrounding darkness.

artworks.title: Sous l'aile d'ombre, l'etre noir appliquait une active morsure (Beneath the wing of shadow the black creature was biting energetically)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged being standing on a barren landscape under a swirling sky. The image features a solitary figure with large wings, depicted in a dark manner. The sky above is rendered in swirling patterns, suggesting movement or change. A spherical object is positioned on the horizon. The drawing combines elements of shadow and light, lending a dramatic tone to the composition.

artworks.title: Pélerin du monde sublunaire (Pilgrim of the sublunary world)
artworks.description: The image contains swirling lines and dark shapes, creating an abstract scene. At the top right, a circular pattern resembles a glowing celestial body. On the left side, faint outlines suggest a figure in robes seated on a shadowy form. The composition hints at a journey through a mysterious landscape.

artworks.title: Le Jour (Day)
artworks.description: This is an image of an interior view through a window. The image shows a view from inside a darkened room looking out through a window, where a tree trunk with branches and leaves is visible. The window is divided into a grid by wooden mullions, creating smaller panes through which the scene outside is observed. The surrounding darkness of the room contrasts with the lighter outdoor scene framed by the window. The simplicity and composition suggest a play of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Yeux Clos (Closed Eyes)
artworks.description: The image shows a person's head and shoulders with eyes closed and head slightly tilted forward. The face has delicate lines and subtle shading. The hair is long and smooth, falling past the shoulders. The person's clothing is not clearly visible, but there are bare shoulders or minimal clothing above the chest. The background is textured with light pencil strokes. There are no visible jewelry pieces or objects. The overall image has a soft, monochromatic appearance, emphasizing the serene facial expression.

artworks.title: Bust of a Man Wearing a High Cap, Three-Quarters Right (The Artist's Father?)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person shown in a seated or standing position, with a slight turn towards the viewer's left. The facial features include a beard and mustache, and the lines in the etching create texture and detail, suggesting a mature or elderly face. The person's head is adorned with a large, soft cap that folds and drapes around the head. Clothing appears to consist of a robe or coat with a textured collar that gives the impression of wool or fur. There are no visible accessories or objects being held by the person. The background is plain and without any noticeable elements.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt: Small
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 9.2 x 6.5 cm (3 5/8 x 2 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rider on a donkey with another figure leading the donkey. The drawing depicts an outdoor scene in which a figure is seated on a donkey, swathed in a cloak. The donkey is loaded with bundles. Another figure, wearing a hat and holding a stick, leads the donkey. The background is filled with trees and greenery. The overall composition is detailed and evokes a sense of movement through a quietly atmospheric landscape. This is in the style of Rembrandt, known for his detailed etchings and masterful use of light and shadow.

artworks.title: The Flight into Egypt: Altered from Seghers
artworks.medium: etching, burin and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated position. The horizon is low, leaving ample space for the sky. In the distance, a strip of land and limited detail can be discerned. Detailed trees with dense foliage are prominent in the foreground. A figure on horseback is visible among the trees to the right, casting shadows. The artwork features intricate detailing, likely achieved through cross-hatching or stippling techniques. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark contrasts typical of etchings.

artworks.title: The Fourth Oriental Head
artworks.artist: Rembrandt van Rijn and Studio of Rembrandt van Rijn after Jan Lievens
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15.9 x 13.2 cm (6 1/4 x 5 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a young man depicted from the waist up, positioned in profile, facing to the right. His head is slightly tilted downward. He has a prominent nose and full lips, with a contemplative expression. His hair is long, wavy, and shoulder-length, cascading beneath a large, voluminous beret that covers the top of his head. He wears a dark cloak over a lighter colored garment, and the texture of both is detailed. There is no visible jewelry or objects being held. The background is plain with no distinct features, emphasizing the figure as the central focus.
